title: New Zealand census population density by SA2
credit: Vardion; Stats NZ 2023 Census and SA2 geographic data; prepared using QGIS
altText: Choropleth map of New Zealand displaying usually resident population density by Statistical Area 2 with legend.
caption: Usually resident population density by Statistical Area 2, derived from the 2023 New Zealand Census and mapped with QGIS in October 2024.
context: A genuine map of census geography and statistical-area units; it shows a later application rather than the original 1940s meshblock definition.
